title: Fresh Basil Pine-Nut Pesto & Zucchini Noodle Linguine
ingredients: Optional toppings: cherry tomatoes, red pepper flakes, additional Parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook the linguine according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
While the linguine is cooking, prepare the zucchini. Trim off the ends and cut the zucchini into thin, long strips resembling linguine using a spiralizer or a vegetable peeler. Set aside.
In a food processor or blender, combine the basil leaves, pine nuts, minced garlic, and grated Parmesan cheese. Pulse until the ingredients are finely chopped.
With the food processor or blender running, slowly drizzle in the olive oil until the mixture forms a smooth and creamy pesto sauce. Add salt and pepper to taste, and blend again to combine.

In a large skillet, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium heat. Add the zucchini noodles and sauté for 2-3 minutes until they are just tender. Be careful not to overcook them, as they can become mushy.

Add the cooked linguine to the skillet with the zucchini noodles. Pour the fresh pesto sauce over the noodles and gently toss to coat everything evenly. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until the sauce is heated through.

Remove from heat and serve the pesto zucchini linguine immediately. Optionally, you can garnish with halved cherry tomatoes, red pepper flakes for a hint of spice, and additional grated Parmesan cheese.
